entry.title: Generativetober Day 29 - Tusk
entry.content:
Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  stroke(255);
  noFill();

  for (let i = 1; i < 5; ++i) {
    let h = 85 * i;
    let x = width-i*100-125;
    let y = 185 - i * 10;

    if (i === 3) {
      stroke(magenta);
    } else if (i == 2) {
      stroke(cyan);
    } else {
      stroke(white);
    }
    
    bezier(
      x, y,
      x-100, y+h*0.6,
      x-100, y+h*0.6,
      x, y+h
    );

    bezier(
      x, y,
      x-50, y+h*0.6,
      x-50, y+h*0.6,
      x+100, y+h
    );
  
    line(x+100, y+h, width-40, y+h);
  }

  noStroke();
  fill(255, 150);
  textSize(16);
  text("Tusk", 10, height - 10);
}

function draw() {
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("tusk.png");
  }
}

Discussion

Maybe I'm getting burned out but this prompt said nothing to me. Maybe if I was painting this or drawing it I would feel differently. It evokes a lot of "monster" type vibes but with this computer art project I'm feeling pretty flat on it.

So what I ended up doing was starting with a single pair of bezier curves that looked a bit like a tusk. I turned this into a loop so I could draw a few of them of different sizes shifting left from the right side as it goes. I added lines to the right from each one and it started to feel like merging "tusk" with "claw". I like the story of the development of this piece but not the piece itself. I have trouble imagining some of these prompts from a more abstract perspective, it's easy to get caught up in a literal interpretation.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 28 - Trophy
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Atrophy {
  constructor(x, y, c, a, decayRate=1) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.color = c;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.alph = a;
    this.decayRate = decayRate;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += random(-2,2);

    if (random() < 0.5) {
      this.y += random(0,2);
    } else {
      this.y += random(-2,2);
    }
  }

  show() {
    this.alph -= this.decayRate;
    if (this.alph > 0) {
      stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
      line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    }
  }
}

let a;
let as = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  noFill();
  stroke(white);

  for (let i = 1; i < 300; i += i) {
    stroke(...white, i);
    for (let j = 1; j < i; j += 10) {
      circle(width/2+j+random(-2,2), height/2+50+i+random(-2,2), 1);
      circle(width/2-j+random(-2,2), height/2+50+i+random(-2,2), 1);
    }
  }

  stroke(white);
  for (let j = 1; j < 6; j++) {
    let r = j*80;
    let cx = width/2;
    let cy = height/2+50;
    for (let i = PI; i < 2*PI; i += 0.075) {
      let x = r*cos(i) + cx;
      let y = r*sin(i) + cy;
      let c;
      if (j == 1 || j == 2 || j == 3) {
        c = white;
      } else if (j == 4) {
        c = cyan;
      } else {
        c = magenta;
      }
      as.push(new Atrophy(x, y, c, map(j, 1, 4, 50, 255), 1/j+0.2));
    }
  }

  noStroke();
  fill(255, 127);
  textSize(16);
  text("Trophy", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  for (let a of as) {
    a.update();
    a.show();
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("trophy.png");
  }
}

Discussion

"A trophy"... "Atrophy"... Decay.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 27 - Dumb
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'left') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'left') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Dumbo {
  constructor(x, y, c) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = random(0, 100);
    this.ty = random(9999, 99999);
    this.color = c;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -1, 1);
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -1, 1);

    if (this.x > width-30 || this.x < 30) {
      this.x = width/2;
    }

    if (this.y > height-30 || this.y < 30) {
      this.y = height/2;
    }

    this.tx += 0.01;
    this.ty += 0.01;
  }

  show() {
    fill(this.color);
    circle(this.x, this.y, 3);

    stroke(this.color);
    noFill();

    let r = random(1, 10);
    let pl = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'left');
    let pr = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'right');
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pl.x-5, pl.y+5,
      pl.x-5, pl.y-5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pr.x+5, pr.y-5,
      pr.x+5, pr.y+5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
  }
}

let ds = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);

  for (let i = 0; i < 50; ++i) {
    ds.push(new Dumbo(random(0, width), random(0, height), random(colors)));
  }
}

function draw() {
  background(0);
  noStroke();

  for (let d of ds) {
    d.update();
    d.show();
  }

  fill(white);
  stroke(white);
  textSize(16);
  text("Dumb", 10, height-10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("dumb.png");
  }
}

entry.title: Generativetober Day 26 - Zip
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'ccw') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'ccw') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Zipper {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.dirx = random([-1, 1]);
    this.diry = random([-1, 1]);
    this.alph = 255;
    this.dira = -1;
    this.color = white;
  }

  update() {
    this.alph += this.dira;
    stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    
    this.x += this.dirx * 5;
    
    this.y += this.diry * 7;

    if (this.x >= width-30 || this.x <= 30) {
      this.dirx *= -1;
      this.x = random(30,width-30);
      this.lastx = this.x;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.y >= height-30 || this.y <= 30) {
      this.diry *= -1;
      this.y = random(30,height-30);
      this.lasty = this.y;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.alph >= 255 || this.alph <= 0) {
      this.dira *= -1;
    }
  }

  show() {
    line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    
    const p2 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'ccw');
    line(this.x, this.y, p2.x, p2.y);

    const p3 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'right');
    line(this.x, this.y, p3.x, p3.y);
  }
}

let z;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);

  z = new Zipper(width/2, height/2);

  noStroke();
  fill(255);
  textSize(16);
  text("Zip", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  z.update();
  z.show();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("zip.png");
  }
}

entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Fracture {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = 0;
    this.ty = 10000;
    this.dirx = random([-1,1]);
    this.diry = random([-1,1]);
  }

  update() {
    this.tx += 0.01;
    let distx = map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, 5, 20);
    let disty = map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, 5, 20);
    
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += distx * this.dirx + random(-40,40);
    this.y += disty * this.diry + random(-40,40);
  }

  show() {
    if (this.x > 0 && this.x < width && this.y > 0 && this.y < height) {
      stroke(...random([white,cyan]), random([50, 100, 150, 200, 250]));
      line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
      if (random() < 0.5) {
        stroke(...random([white,cyan]), random([50, 100, 150, 200, 250]));
        line(
          this.x + random(-3, 3),
          this.y + random(-3, 3),
          this.lastx + random(-3, 3),
          this.lasty + random(-3, 3)
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

let fracture;
let fractures = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  for (let i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
    fractures.push(new Fracture(
      random(width/2-20,width/2+20), random(height/2+20, height/2-20)));
  }
  
  fill(...white, 25);

  fill(white);
  textSize(16);
  text("Fracture", 10, height-10);

  stroke(255);
}

function draw() {
  for (let f of fractures) {
    f.update();
    f.show();
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("fracture.png");
  }
}
